feature: Toppan delivery gate: stage RD1-DR3 maju hanya setelah file terkonfirmasi di SFTP (dengan bypass bila upload Toppan diblokir config)
note: Mekanisme OCMS-DEV-2026-199 / OCMS-DF-2026-192 ini dipakai OCMS12.2 tetapi tidak ada di story manapun yang diberikan: gate menunggu COMCRYPT operation record terhapus, dan di-bypass bila sftp.upload.disabledServers memuat toppan. Apakah ada story lain yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: This OCMS-DEV-2026-199 / OCMS-DF-2026-192 mechanism is used by OCMS12.2 but is not in any story given: the gate waits for the COMCRYPT operation record to be deleted, and is bypassed when sftp.upload.disabledServers contains toppan. Whether another story covers it has not been checked.

feature: Ringkasan batch SMS dan email kegagalan SMS ke tim operasi
note: sendSmsBatchSummaryEmail dan sendBatchFailureEmail mengirim ringkasan hasil batch SMS dan daftar kegagalan ke email.report.recipients. Tidak disebut di OCMS12.4; story lain yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: sendSmsBatchSummaryEmail and sendBatchFailureEmail send the SMS batch result summary and the failure list to email.report.recipients. Not mentioned in OCMS12.4; whether another story covers it has not been checked.

feature: TS-HST otomatis untuk offender HST setelah eNotification berhasil
note: Setelah SMS/email terkirim, job memeriksa ocms_hst dalam satu batch dan menerapkan TS-HST per notice. Ini bukan bagian OCMS12.3-12.5; story HST yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: After the SMS/email is sent, the job checks ocms_hst in one batch and applies TS-HST per notice. It is not part of OCMS12.3-12.5; the HST story that covers it has not been checked.
